label: late original-phase positions (t>=6) with sparse content gating
explanation: Fires almost only in the original phase at late positions (orig_idx 5-8, rate peaks ~5% at t=7-8), mostly the last 1-3 tokens before <DEL> in long sequences (L=8-9 carry 86% of mass). It never fires in the copy phase and only weakly at the delimiter (1% of mass). t>=6 in the original phase covers 92% of activations and 94% of mass, but only ~4% of those steps are active, so which of them fire depends on content in a diffuse way. Enriched cues: first token n (7.9x lift, the largest), current input u (5x), previous input w (7x), and next-out n. Even combined, these reach only F1 ~0.23. Top activations (up to 3.1) are mostly sequences starting with n that have input u or a token after w near the end. Weak or none at t<5 and on short sequences (L<=5).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev_tok=w (+3.38), orig0=n (+3.19), orig2=y (+2.32), orig1=y (+2.22), orig1=l (+1.71), prev2_tok=w (+1.68). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-9.04), phase=2 (-5.85), orig0=m (-5.25), t=3 (-4.54).
